The Synthesis Stack (synthesis.openie.dev) [E/M/S · reported_j]

Maps AI routing across 7 axes (Z1 lookup, Z2 verifier-backed code/math, Z3 open prose), qualifies 90.62% as 29/32 on a BigCodeBench slice (0/32 escapes -> 95% UB <= 10.89%) & notes Pattern-lang is BSL-1.1.

1/2 Sample bounds, NVMe latency & lineage:
- 29/32 is a 32-task slice (full BigCodeBench has 1,140 tasks); unit-test gates cover only tested invariants
- 970 MB AirMoL streams Qwen3.6-35B-A3B from SSD (trading flash latency for RAM)
- Builds on FrugalGPT, RouteLLM & Outlines [S]

2/2 Open-ended limits & repo licenses:
- Z3 creative prose has no binary C(z)=1 gate
- Pattern-lang (openIE-dev/pattern-lang) is BSL-1.1 source-restricted; open Apache-2.0 cascade scripts live in openIE-dev/lut-adapt-ai & mixture-of-limits
- M5 Max reported_j (measured_j = null)
